title: Bug Report: Typo in /help Command - Incorrect Spelling of /compact
body:
Description:
When using the /help command, it shows `/compac` but the correct command should be `/compact` with a 't' at the end.

Environment:
- Platform: macOS
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.18
- Feedback ID: 01eba31f-6cde-406c-9e9c-c7285c0646e7

The errors appear to be related to the Claude Code CLI tool's internal functionality and authentication mechanisms.

Note: Full error logs were truncated for brevity.
author: nanthanwa
